title: The monument becomes a machine
governingQuestion: What must a Paris room become before it can carry a show?
status: evidence-backed production draft; recording, interviews and owner-final approval remain open

longform.headline: The monument becomes a machine
longform.opening: The Paris runway is not a venue. It is a temporary conversion of the city.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: Paris Fashion Week is distributed across house-selected locations; the FHCM calendar specifies physical and digital formats rather than one permanent runway.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: Municipal event rules form one public layer, but they do not disclose a named show’s lighting, power, scenic, accessibility or teardown plan.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: Venue contracts, permits, suppliers and technical drawings remain show-by-show reporting assignments unless a house, venue or authority publishes them.

longform.closing: Paris Fashion Week is not one technology. It is a chain of permissions that turns recognition into circulation and circulation into memory.
